'''Bertain Gallenne''' was the Lord Captain of [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]]'s Winged Guards from [[Mayene]]. 

== Appearance ==
He had graying hair and wore a black eye-patch over his missing eye. He was of medium height. He didn't think about much else except how to attack.

== Activities ==
=== Finding the Prophet ===
He accompanied [[Perrin Aybara]] and Berelain into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]]. He accompanied Berelain into [[Bethal]] to meet with Queen [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]].

He was with Berelain when Perrin found the [[Darkhound]] tracks and then accompanied Perrin when he looked over the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] camped in [[Malden]].
He went with Perrin and Berelain to [[So Habor]], where they collected grain for their troops.

He was again guarding Berelain when she and Perrin made their deal with the [[Seanchan]].
He led the Mayene forces in the [[Battle of Malden]], but his main duty was for him and his men to guard Berelain.

While traveling from Malden, he was with Perrin when they found land that appeared to have been affected by the [[Great Blight|Blight]]. Later he attended a meeting with Perrin and others to receive a report on how well the [[Wise Ones]] and the [[Aes Sedai]] cleaned up the infected land.{{ref/book|13|6}}  In that meeting they also decided how the army should deal with the [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]]. During that meeting [[Seonid]] and Perrin both confirmed that a [[Forsaken]] had occupied [[Andor]] for a spell until [[Rand al'Thor]] rooted him out. [[Morgase Trakand]], in the personage of Maighdin, was present and requested to be excused.{{ref/book|13|6}}

===Encounter with the Whitecloaks===
Gallenne was in the army escort provided Perrin as he moved to meet with the Whitecloaks for the first time after Malden. {{ref/book|13|21}}

After Perrin and [[Slayer]] battled in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', he, along with [[Gerard Arganda]], was consulted about where an ambush would be appropriately set up on the road down which they travel. He was also present or nearby when Perrin, with the help of [[Asha'man]] [[Fager Neald]] and several Wise Ones, constructed his [[Mah'alleinir|Power-wrought hammer]].{{ref/book|13|40}}

He led the Mayene cavalry in defense of the Whitecloaks in the surprise [[Trolloc]] attack that occurred shortly after the conclusion of Perrin's trial, and questioned Perrin about what he owed the Whitecloaks. Perrin's response led him to call Perrin "strange" and "an honorable man." {{ref/book|13|41}}

He participated in the parade led by Perrin as they marched off to the [[Field of Merrilor]] through a huge [[gateway]] formed by [[Jur Grady]], Neald, and several others who could channel.{{ref/book|13|53}}

Gallenne is one of the commanding officers who discuss with [[Elayne Trakand]] information gathered from all the war-fronts. Perrin grabs his attention and tells everyone that he must leave the army. Perrin places [[Tamlin al'Thor]] in charge of the army in his absence. Gallenne was killed in the battle outside [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]] against the [[Shadowspawn]] army in the [[Last Battle]]. Despite the constant arguments he and Arganda had shared, Arganda mourned him deeply and took a plume from Gallenne's helmet and added it to his own.
